title: Live Update 1.33.0
body:
# Live Update 1.33.0

Raiders,

A strange alliance is taking shape in the Rust Belt.

The Nomadic Envoys have made their way to Speranza, carrying with them information collected during their journeys across the Rust Belt. They may hold clues about why ARC activity appears to be expanding.

They may be willing to trade that knowledge, but trust has to be earned first. Head Topside to gather supplies, recover lost relics, and help keep travel routes safe for those passing through dangerous territory.

# **WHAT'S NEW?**

## **Forgotten Relics Event**

Raiders can earn rewards through Merits, which are generated automatically from the XP gained while playing on any map. These Merits unlock a variety of rewards, including gameplay items, weapons, and Raider Tokens.

More Merits can be gathered by searching for relics hidden across the world, often stashed inside containers such as lockers, drawers, and crates. Every relic has its own Merit value based on rarity, but Raiders only receive those Merits if they extract successfully while carrying the relic.

Advancing through the event also grants the Saltwalker Outfit along with its toggles and other rewards. Merits collected from Forgotten Relics also count toward progress in the Converging Paths project.

## **Converging Paths Project**

This Project runs from June 16 through July 27 and tasks Raiders with keeping safe passage open for the nomads, collecting essential supplies, and recovering forgotten relics while Topside.

Completing each stage moves forward the progress of a Display Case, which showcases the relics found along the way. Raiders who complete the entire project will receive the Red-Black color variant of the Saltwalker Outfit, a Sextant backpack charm, and Raider Tokens, bringing this season's total earnable Raider Tokens to 300.

## **No Free Loadout - Night Raid and Close Scrutiny**

Free loadouts are being turned off for Night Raid and Close Scrutiny. This raises the entry cost for these modes so that players take on appropriate risk for the improved loot they offer.

This change is temporary and will be tested over the next three weeks. Depending on how it affects gameplay and what feedback we receive, we may extend this restriction to other map conditions later on.

## **The Reaver Set Bundle**

# **Patch Highlights**

* Fixed unusual behavior while aiming down sights that was affecting aim accuracy on some weapons.

* Players will no longer sometimes fall through the map when stepping on Fireballs and Pop parts.

* Barricades can continue expanding after deployment even if the player who placed them is knocked out.

* The Rocketeer now drops Launcher Ammo instead of Heavy Ammo.

* Ermal's offers now show correct stack sizes, for example "Raider Tokens x25".

* Extraction call announcements now play correctly.

* Fixed missing audio when dismantling Barricade Kits.

# **CONTENT AND BUG FIXES**

## GENERAL

* Fixed unusual behavior while aiming down sights that was affecting aim accuracy on some weapons.

* Players will no longer sometimes fall through the map when stepping on Fireballs and Pop parts.

* Fixed a rare issue where quest objectives could trigger out of sequence, causing later steps to show up before they should.

* Expedition damage tracking now excludes damage dealt by squad members.

## ANIMATION

* Fixed an issue where a Raider could briefly T-pose while moving backward right after a sprint Dodge Roll.

* Fixed an issue where long weapons could detach and appear behind the player when switching weapons right after vaulting; equip and unequip animations now play as intended.

* The Sandveil outfit no longer stretches unnaturally around the neck and shoulders.

## ARC

* The Rocketeer now drops Launcher Ammo instead of Heavy Ammo.

* Fixed an issue where the Firefly could sometimes drop an incendiary grenade without being destroyed.

* Queen and Matriarch can now plant their feet properly across more varied terrain, and can also stand on moving surfaces.

## AUDIO

* Extraction call announcements now play correctly.

* Fixed missing audio when dismantling the Barricade Kit.

* Improved audio cues for Raider Caches so they're easier to locate.

* Adjusted footstep volume levels for standing still, walking, crouching, running, and sprinting; increased the metal slide volume for clearer movement audio.

## MAPS

* Players can no longer fall through the map near the wall of the Pilgrim's Peak building.

## SOCIAL

* Adding friends from outside the game now updates their in-game presence status if they own the game.

## UI

* Ermal's offers now show correct stack sizes, for example "Raider Tokens x25".

* Added input shortcuts to the inventory action menu: Sell, Recycle, Repair (gamepad only), Salvage, and Drop.

* Fixed an issue where selecting Upgrade on a weapon could open a different weapon when managing large inventories.

* Fixed an issue where the expedition damage tracker failed to show the correct damage total once a player had dealt significant damage.

* Updated the Free Loadout warning so it correctly accounts for refilling item stacks when checking available inventory space.

* Fixed an issue where merging stacks in the stash didn't refill correctly with overflowing items.

* Selecting Free Loadout no longer clears the current loadout until a round has actually been played.

* The Inventory screen now correctly shows the Free Loadout instead of an empty inventory when readied up.

* Fixed jitter in the health and armor bar during healing.

* Opening the console menu on PS5/Xbox while matchmaking no longer cancels the matchmaking process.

* In-game countdowns for Map Conditions will now only appear 60 minutes before those conditions go live.

* **Dev note**: Beyond this visual change, we are actively looking into further improvements to Map Conditions based on player feedback, including separate schedules for different timezones for better coverage. Information on which Map Conditions are live throughout the day, and when, can be found on the map conditions schedule page.

## UTILITY

* Knocked out players no longer prevent Barricade Kits from continuing to expand after deployment.

* Fixed an issue where the healing cloud from the Tactical Mk.3 Healing augment could revive DBNO players.

# **KNOWN ISSUES**

* We know some PC players may experience lower FPS than usual.

* While we investigate, please make sure your GPU drivers are up to date, or try rolling back to a previous driver version if the issue continues.

* We are investigating an ongoing issue causing crashes for some XBOX players, particularly on Series S.

* We are looking into reports of unwanted behavior related to the Quick Wheel.

* The Dolabra, Hullcracker, and Rascal do not deal damage to training dummies on the Practice Range.

* The throw animation may occasionally fail to play when trying to detonate a Trigger 'Nade immediately after throwing it.

* Some gadgets and throwables are missing a "Cancel" button when preparing to throw them.

* The weapon swap animation may look broken if you swap weapons right after vaulting.

* Player animations may appear broken when a search of the Baron Husk is interrupted.

* Some hairstyles may clip through the Reaver outfit helmet.

* The Saltwalker outfit preview on the Forgotten Relics page may incorrectly show two toggles for each element.

* Shredders float up to the ceiling in some rooms of the Hidden Bunker.

* The Leaper can jump through the ARC Turbine.

* The Access Capacitor Rack may occasionally spawn without interactable batteries.

* When picking up items, the pickup sound played may not be the correct one.

* Items that grant Merits will incorrectly show a Merits icon when brought into a Raid.

* Shots fired while riding ARC may not register correctly.

* After a player is revived, some Augments' health restoration effects no longer pause when they take damage.

# **ANTI-CHEAT**

As part of our continued effort against unfair play, we are expanding Denuvo Anti-Cheat to more players. We're pleased with progress so far and expect further improvements as we scale it up further. We have also been focused on tackling item duplication and taking strict action against those responsible. This involves carefully identifying incidents, addressing them directly, and putting safeguards in place to stop them from recurring. It is slow, detailed work, and we appreciate your patience as we carry it out. We have also added a new inbox message to notify you when action has been taken against a player you reported. Going forward, you may receive two types of messages depending on the situation:

* **Action Notice:** A confirmation message sent once we have banned a player you reported.

* **Loot Compensation**: If we identify a cheater who knocked you out, your lost loot will be returned to you automatically through an inbox message. No report is required for this.

Since these notifications work independently, you may sometimes receive both. For instance, if you report a cheater who also knocked you out, you could receive both an action notice and your returned loot at the same time.

Anti-cheat work remains one of our top priorities, and we will keep you updated as we continue working to keep the game fair. We appreciate your continued feedback and reports, and thank you for being part of this journey through Topside.

# **THE ROAD TO OCTOBER**

As most of you already know, October will bring our biggest update so far. Most of the ARC Raiders team is currently focused on building the new map, bringing ARC to life, planning new progression paths, writing quests, testing weapons, and yes, recording new instruments.

We understand that this quieter stretch takes some adjusting to, and we recognize the desire for more content in the meantime. Our approach is to deliver shorter-term content through Projects and Events while building something substantial for October, and then continuing that cadence every six months after.

Because we now separate Live Updates from Content Updates, we're able to build a genuinely exciting Fall experience. On top of that, our dedicated live service team can respond more quickly to issues and bugs, and test balance changes more thoroughly, which will keep improving the overall health of ARC Raiders.

Please keep sharing your feedback and suggestions. We are constantly adjusting and looking for ways to improve. There is more coming throughout the Summer and in the lead-up to Frozen Trail. The work is far from finished.

See you Topside,
The ARC Raiders Team
